en: A colorized (hand-tinted) historic postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex above a town. The fortress has long, pale stone walls, multiple gabled roofs, and a prominent round tower with a crenellated top. Below the castle are trees and several houses with red or gray roofs. In the bottom-right corner, there is printed German text identifying the scene and the publisher.
